title: Location
intro: Set your observing location to search for cutouts by clicking the sky.

latitude.label: Latitude (°)
latitude.help: Your position north or south of the equator, in decimal degrees. North is positive and south is negative; for example, 19.43.

longitude.label: Longitude (°)
longitude.help: Your position east or west of the Greenwich meridian, in decimal degrees. East is positive and west is negative; for example, −99.13.

validation: Enter a latitude from −90° to 90° and a longitude from −180° to 180°.

notices.locating: Getting your location. When it is ready, click the sky point again.
notices.required: Set latitude and longitude in Location to search by clicking the sky.

errors.unsupported: Automatic location requires HTTPS or localhost and a compatible browser. Enter latitude and longitude in Location or search by RA/Dec in Preparation.
errors.timeout: Location could not be obtained in time. Try again or enter latitude and longitude in Location.
errors.denied: Location permission was not granted. Allow it in your browser or enter latitude and longitude in Location.
errors.unavailable: Your device could not determine your location. Try again or enter latitude and longitude in Location.
